notes.title: Shadow Warrior Update 1.1
notes.content:
Shadow Warrior has been updated.
The Sound and Game will now run smoothly for Windows 7 - 10 users.

The game has also been moved to a new foldername (Shadow Warrior DOS) to avoid conflicts with Devolver Digital's SW games on Steam. 

In order to move Shadow Warrior, to a few folder, we suggest re-installing the game.
